functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The login page must be accessible within 2 seconds after the user completes the registration process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a smooth transition from registration to login, ensuring a user-friendly experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and guidance if the user enters incorrect credentials, including suggestions for common issues (e.g., case sensitivity, password reset).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, and clear error messages help prevent frustration and improve the user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: User credentials must be transmitted over a secure connection using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user data, and secure transmission is essential to protect user credentials.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must validate user credentials against a secure and tamper-proof authentication service.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires verifying user credentials, and ensuring data integrity is crucial to prevent unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The login page must be available 99.9% of the time to ensure users can access the application after registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the application, necessitating high availability of the login page.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must automatically update all dataset instances to the new version without manual intervention within 5 minutes of the new version being deployed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires seamless updates to dataset instances, ensuring that all instances are using the latest code.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must complete the update process for all dataset instances within 5 minutes of the new version being deployed, for up to 1,000 instances.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a timely update process, which is critical for maintaining the application's performance and reliability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory per dataset instance during the update process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is important to ensure that the update process does not impact the overall performance of the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from any update failures and retry the update process for affected dataset instances up to 3 times.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a robust update mechanism, and fault tolerance ensures that updates are successfully applied even in the face of transient issues.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for the configuration of update policies, such as the maximum number of concurrent updates and the retry mechanism, through a centralized management interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a complex update process, and modifiability ensures that the system can be adjusted to meet changing requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must verify the integrity of the new dataset type version before applying it to dataset instances, using a digital signature or checksum.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves deploying new code, and ensuring the integrity of the code is crucial to prevent the application of corrupted or malicious updates.
